title: Outlaws of Thunder Junction/The Big Score

paragraphs.text: The Big Score (a.k.a. The Vault ) is a bonus sheet of 30 cards that is associated with Outlaws of Thunder Junction . It was released on April 19, 2024.

Due to negative feedback on March of the Machine: The Aftermath , the planned Epilogue Booster pack cards for Outlaws of Thunder Junction were incorporated as an extra bonus sheet in the regular Play Boosters . Cards from The Big Score have retained their own set symbol and set code (BIG). They are Standard legal.
From the original 50 cards of the "Aftermath-style" set, 30 appear on the Bonus sheet and Jace Reawakened was swapped with Grand Abolisher into the main set. The rest didn’t get used.

Showcase versions of the cards "Vault" card treatment and alternate art are BIG #31-60. These only appear in Collector Boosters . Of the vault frame cards, 5 also appear in raised foil with a special elevated golden stamp embedded in the frame to commemorate the shiniest loot from Oko's heist (BIG #61-65). Extended art version of the regular cards are BIG #66-95.
Cards from The Big Score appear as part of The List for Outlaws of Thunder Junction .
The Big Score has seven tokens , found in Outlaws of Thunder Junction Play and Collector boosters:
2/1 Bat creature with flying for Greed's Gambit .
Blood artifact with " , , Discard a card, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card." for Transmutation Font .
0/0 Construct artifact creature with “This creature gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.” for Simulacrum Synthesizer .
Food artifact with " , , Sacrifice this token: You gain 3 life." for Bristlebud Farmer and Transmutation Font .
1/1 Gnome artifact creature for Oltec Matterweaver .
3/3 Golem artifact creature for Legion Extruder and Sandstorm Salvager .
Map artifact with " , , Sacrifice this token: Target creature you control explores. Activate only as a sorcery." for Worldwalker Helm .
The following tokens are created by cards in the set but are not included in the The Big Score token set. Instead, they retain the Outlaws of Thunder Junction expansion symbol and collector number:
Copy for Esoteric Duplicator ; Molten Duplication ; Nexus of Becoming ; Oltec Matterweaver ; Vaultborn Tyrant and Worldwalker Helm .
Clue artifact with " , Sacrifice this token: Draw a card." for Hostile Investigator and Transmutation Font .
Treasure artifact with " , Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color." for Generous Plunderer and Sword of Wealth and Power .
